Name: Btkki's Highres Makup Templete
Author: Whiterabbitv
Description:
THisis a makeup set that includes high-resolution lenses, brows, blusher and lips.
You need [Fashion] Sense mod(category:acc)

[u]You CAN change the "COLOR" of the lenses and shadow a little.  [/u](too much changes can look awkward)


file description

1. blush: including blusher, blusher+lips, ★brows(with blusher and lips) 1~4, blush with shadow.
  -You cna useblush with shadow as base of lenses. (ex: you can match acc1slot as a cat eye lens, and acc2slot as a shadow)

2. Lens-front: this is a highres-lenses, which is loaded "afterf" the hair(places in front of the hair). So the character's hair is covered by the eyes. see sample images.

3. Lens-back: Also highres-lense, which is loaded "before" the hair(places back of the hair). So the lenses are covered by character's hair. see sample images.




Thanks!
